nina: quick heads-up - running through the Dedicated python async sample against our private cluster and hit SSL verify + typing woes.
omar: what error?
nina: `ssl.SSLCertVerificationError` + my IDE flagged client param typing mismatch. async client signature shows `verify: bool` in stub but runtime accepts str path.
kai: that mismatch is bad for DX. typed client should be `Union[bool, str]` and docstring mention env fallback.
omar: agree. also our async wrapper for aiohttp currently ignores `verify` when it's a str. it only supports True/False.
nina: repro snippet:
```python
client = RedwoodClient(base_url=os.getenv('REDWOOD_BASE_URL'), api_key=KEY, verify='/etc/ssl/redwood-ca.pem', async_mode=True)
await client.chat.create(...)
```
ci-bot: lint: typing-error in clients/async_client.pyi line 42.
kai: plan: 1) fix typing stubs to accept str|bool 2) wire aiohttp.TCPConnector(ssl=ssl_context) when verify is str 3) support REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE env var fallback.
omar: side request: accept inline PEM via REDWOOD_CA_INLINE (use newlines) since k8s secrets sometimes mount it that way.
nina: also hit retry duplication: async client retried POST on 502 and our inference backend ran twice. we should mark generation endpoints non-idempotent by default.
kai: add parameter `safe_retry=True` default to avoid non-idempotent retries. allow override for advanced users.
alex: i'll open PR that covers typing, aiohttp ssl fix, env parsing, and adds a tiny integ test against a local devserver with custom CA. will also add a short note in onboarding docs.
omar: CI flake note - tests that create temporary SSL files must cleanup on windows path length issues.

kai: yep, log-level warn with suggestion: "use gateway FQDN or set REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE".
